summary: 並列Agentは`claude --worktree`等でAgentごとに分離checkoutを持ち、委譲時に基準commit SHAとbranchを明示し、統合前にrebase/差分確認を必須にする

evidence.summary: Claude Code公式: `claude --worktree <name>`で既存commitからの分離checkoutで並列session、@file参照で明示的にfileを投入(directory参照は一覧のみ)、subagentへ探索委譲、`!`コマンドで実行結果を接地、Claudeは最新のClaude Code docsへ常時アクセス
AgenticFlict(R12, preprint): AI coding Agent PRのmerge conflictを大規模に分析。並列Agentの同時変更が競合を生む(数値は台帳R12参照、今回未再取得)
Anthropic Managed Agents: sessionをcontext window外に置くappend-only event logとして扱い、harness失敗後もwake(sessionId)/getEventsで状態を復元

ce-worktree (public, reputation established): pass 1 read the skills.sh page: 'Ensure the current work happens in an isolated workspace, without disturbing the user's main checkout' - detects existing isolation, prefers native worktree tooling with a plain-git fallback, and supports branching from a base trunk or isolating an existing ref.

applies_when: 複数Agent/複数sessionが同一repositoryを同時に変更

expected_effect.primary: 異なる時点のrepositoryを見た作業の混入・conflict削減

risks: worktree増加によるdisk/依存install重複(devcontainerで緩和)
cost: worktree運用と委譲テンプレート
known_failure_modes: 同一working treeで複数Agentを並列実行
委譲後にmainが進んでも再基準化しない

detect whether the session is already isolated before creating another worktree
create the worktree from an explicit base trunk, or isolate an existing ref (PR, branch, commit)
